description_en: Queries the list of teams under a specified instance, with support for fuzzy filtering by name and pagination
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下的团队列表，支持按名称模糊过滤及分页
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-teams --instance-id agentteams-test-001 --name-like my --max-results 10 --next-token 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTeams

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy match of team names
parameters.help_zh: 团队名称模糊匹配关键字
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数，取值 1-100，默认 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the offset integer string returned by the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌，为上一页返回的偏移量整数字符串
parameters.name: next_token
